widgets_values:
Hard mandatory lock rule: Every frame strictly inherits all features of the reference character in the provided first frame. Keep identical facial features, hairstyle, outfit, makeup, lighting, background, facial proportions and body contour. No face swapping, clothing changes, background replacement, drastic light difference or large-scale body deformation. Only tiny, slow, subtle movements allowed. The frame at 0.00 seconds is exactly consistent with the provided first frame in composition, lighting and character pose.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic live-action, keep the reference image's character, framing and lighting unchanged; only tiny, slow, natural movements. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, cut to a soft close-up with shallow depth of field, subtle expression change, static camera. [Shot 3] At 00:04.500, cut to a medium shot, gentle body movement, background stays unchanged, camera pulls back slowly. [Shot 4] At 00:06.500, cut to a medium close-up, the character holds the final pose until the end of the video.

overall_soundscape: Quiet ambient room tone, soft subtle fabric rustling and gentle breathing, no dialogue.

non_diegetic_music: Slow and mild instrumental bed, soft piano and light strings, warm and calm, fading out on the final shot.
